name: Kobashi Ouichirou
source:
"A nice person wouldn't lock people up in a place like this."

A gloomy man who was invited to the castle.
He's arrogant, cold-hearted, and practical.
Foreign to the idea of fun, he seems to be bored of everything.
For some reason, he acts especially cold towards [url=/c53686]Zakuro[/url].
